name: XCOM 2
description: Base XCOM 2 game: vanilla strategy layer, weapons, armor, research and facilities (pre-War of the Chosen).
attribution_text: Firaxis Games / 2K Games (facts only, no bundled assets -- ADR-0008)
ingestion_notes: Authored from UFOpaedia XCOM 2 pages (ufopaedia.org) and Fextralife XCOM 2 wiki cross-references, November 2026. No official SDK/INI access was available during authoring; numeric values are cited to the specific wiki page that stated them, and fields the sources did not state are intentionally left out rather than guessed (docs/DATA_SOURCING.md). See docs/DATA_SOURCING.md for the per-fact source list. Phase 7 additions: soldier ranks (Fextralife class pages); squaddie Aim per class (Ranger 68, Grenadier 67, Sharpshooter 75, Specialist 68, Rookie 65) and squaddie Health 7 at Rookie difficulty / 5 at Legend (the page states Legend is 2 lower), from the Fextralife XCOM 2 wiki Aim and Health pages. Stats the sources do not state (Will, Mobility, Dodge, Hacking, Veteran/Commander Health) are intentionally absent rather than guessed. Advanced/Superior weapon-upgrade tiers carry descriptive effects only; no numeric bonuses are recorded because no source was verified. Basic weapon upgrades require the Modular Weapons research (Fextralife Weapon Parts, UFOpaedia Weapons (XCOM2), GamePressure weapon upgrades). Advanced/Superior unlock conditions were not verified and are not recorded.
